key.description: The family to publish the next version of: lowercase letters, digits and dashes, opening on an alphanumeric, the same shape a workflow's `agreements[].key` takes. A key nobody has published starts a new family at version 1.

type.description: The family's classification. Must match the type of every version already published under `key`.

allOf.description: What an agreement family is: terms, or a privacy notice. A property of the family rather than of one version, so every version published under one `key` classifies the same way.
allOf.title: AgreementType
